-- What a client importing `Proof.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.Walkers` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def smd.reconBelow (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (F : smd.PathSet) : Option
    smd.PathSet :=
  have ns := smd.atomicNodes S t F;
  if smd.FSet.isEmpty ns = true then none else some (smd.FSet.map (fun x => p ++ x) ns)

def smd.rwCore (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.RWSt) (ps :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Path) (fs tv rem add sp : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tr,
      typedPointsto w
          { value' := tv, schema' := sc, fieldSet' := fs, typeRef' := tr, path' := ps, isAtomic' := st.isAtomic,
            toRemove' := rem, toAdd' := add, spareWalkers' := sp }
          (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        smd.isTypeRef tr st.t ∗ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝)

def smd.rwOwn (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.RWSt) (F R A : Option smd.PathSet) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(∃ ps fs tv rem add sp,
      smd.rwCore w sc S st ps fs tv rem add sp ∗
        smd.ownPath ps st.path ∗
          smd.isSetO fs F ∗
            smd.isSetO rem R ∗
              smd.isSetO add A ∗ smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.reconcileWithSchemaWalker sp)

def smd.ownCmp (c : Loc) (C : smd.Cmp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ r m a,
      typedPointsto c { Removed' := r, Modified' := m, Added' := a } (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        smd.ownSet r C.removed ∗ smd.ownSet m C.modified ∗ smd.ownSet a C.added)

def smd.cwCore (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.CWSt) (ps :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Path) (c sp : Loc) (a :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Allocator) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tr,
      typedPointsto w
          { lhs' := st.lhs, rhs' := st.rhs, schema' := sc, typeRef' := tr, path' := ps, comparison' := c,
            inLeaf' := st.inLeaf, spareWalkers' := sp, allocator' := a }
          (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        smd.isTypeRef tr st.t ∗ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝)

def smd.cmpBelow (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (l r : Option smd.UVal) : smd.Cmp
    :=
  if smd.leafAt S t l r = true then smd.leafC p l r
  else
    match S.find t.name with
    | some (smd.Atom.list e rel ks) => smd.cmpListOut (smd.fuelO l r - 1) S e ks p (smd.listItems l) (smd.listItems r)
    | some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel) => smd.cmpMapOut (smd.fuelO l r - 1) S fs e p (smd.mapItems l) (smd.mapItems r)
    | x => smd.Cmp.none

def smd.fuelM (ls rs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) : Nat :=
  smd.UVal.sizeM ls + smd.UVal.sizeM rs + 1

def smd.leafAt (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : Option smd.UVal) : Bool :=
  match S.find t.name with
  | some (smd.Atom.scalar s) => true
  | some (smd.Atom.list elem rel keys) =>
    decide (rel = smd.ElemRel.atomic) || (smd.listItems l).isEmpty && (smd.listItems r).isEmpty
  | some (smd.Atom.map fields elem rel) =>
    decide (rel = smd.ElemRel.atomic) || (smd.mapItems l).isEmpty && (smd.mapItems r).isEmpty
  | none => false

def smd.twCore (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.TWSt) (ps :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Path) (s sp : Loc) (a :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Allocator) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tr,
      typedPointsto w
          { value' := st.value, schema' := sc, typeRef' := tr, set' := s, path' := ps, spareWalkers' := sp,
            allocator' := a }
          (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        smd.isTypeRef tr st.t ∗ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝)

def smd.outRep (o : Loc) : Option smd.UVal → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜o = null⌝)
  | some x => iprop(∃ i, typedPointsto o i DFrac.discard ∗ smd.isIface i x)

def smd.fuelO (l r : Option smd.UVal) : Nat :=
  smd.sizeO l + smd.sizeO r + 1

structure smd.RWSt : Type where
  t : smd.TypeRef
  path : smd.Path
  isAtomic : Bool

def smd.confO (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) : Option smd.UVal → Prop :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => True
  | some x => smd.conforms S t x

def smd.twOwn (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.TWSt) (s : Loc) (F : smd.PathSet) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(∃ ps sp a,
      smd.twCore w sc S st ps s sp a ∗
        smd.ownPath ps st.path ∗
          smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.toFieldSetWalker sp ∗
            smd.isAlloc a ∗ smd.ownSet s F)

def smd.mwOwn (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.MWSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ps sp a,
      smd.mwCore w sc S st ps sp a ∗
        smd.ownPath ps st.path ∗
          smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.mergingWalker sp ∗ smd.isAlloc a)

def smd.noErrs (errs : GoSlice) : IProp GF :=
  smd.ownErrs errs []

def smd.ownErrs (errs : GoSlice) (es : List
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.ValidationError) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownSlice errs es (DFrac.own 1) ∗
      ownSliceCap sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.ValidationError errs (DFrac.own 1))

def smd.mapOfO : Option smd.UVal → Option (List (GoString × smd.UVal)) :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (smd.UVal.map kvs) => some kvs
  | x => none

def smd.reconOut (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (b : Bool) (F : smd.PathSet) :
    Option smd.PathSet :=
  have ns := smd.atomicNodes S t F;
  if (smd.reconTouch S t b F || !smd.FSet.isEmpty ns) = true then
    some ((if smd.reconTouch S t b F = true then smd.ins p else smd.empty).union (smd.FSet.map (fun x => p ++ x) ns))
  else none

def smd.pooledAs (T : go.GoType) (P : Loc → IProp GF) (x : GoAny) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ w, ⌜x = interface.mkOk T.PointerType (intoVal w)⌝ ∗ P w)

def smd.vwOwn (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.VWSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ sp a,
      smd.vwCore w sc S st sp a ∗
        smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.validatingObjectWalker sp ∗ smd.isAlloc a)

def smd.mergeO (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : Option smd.UVal) : Option smd.UVal :=
  smd.mergeF (smd.fuelO l r) S t l r

def smd.cmpO (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (l r : Option smd.UVal) : smd.Cmp :=
  smd.cmpF (smd.fuelO l r) S t p l r

def smd.isSetO (p : Loc) : Option smd.PathSet → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some s => smd.isSet p s

structure smd.MWSt : Type where
  lhs : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value
  rhs : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value
  t : smd.TypeRef
  path : smd.Path
  out : Option smd.UVal
  inLeaf : Bool

structure smd.TWSt : Type where
  value : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value
  t : smd.TypeRef
  path : smd.Path

def smd.cwOwn (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.CWSt) (c : Loc) (C : smd.Cmp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ps sp a,
      smd.cwCore w sc S st ps c sp a ∗
        smd.ownPath ps st.path ∗
          smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.compareWalker sp ∗ smd.isAlloc a ∗ smd.ownCmp c C)

def smd.ownPath (s : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Path) (p : smd.Path) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(smd.isPathF s (DFrac.own 1) p ∗
      ownSliceCap sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement s (DFrac.own 1))

def smd.vwPooled (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v,
      typedPointsto w v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.validatingObjectWalker v.spareWalkers' ∗
          (⌜v.allocator' = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ smd.isAlloc v.allocator'))

def smd.reconTouch (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (b : Bool) (F : smd.PathSet) : Bool :=
  !b &&
    match S.find t.name with
    | some (smd.Atom.list elem smd.ElemRel.atomic keys) => true
    | some (smd.Atom.map fields elem smd.ElemRel.atomic) => !smd.FSet.isEmpty F
    | x => false

def smd.mergeMapOut (n : Nat) (S : smd.Schema) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option
    smd.TypeRef) (ls rs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) : Option smd.UVal :=
  have out :=
    List.filterMap
      (fun x =>
        match x with
        | (k, a, b) =>
          match smd.fieldType fs e k with
          | some t' => Option.map (fun v => (k, v)) (smd.mergeF n S t' a b)
          | none => none)
      (smd.zipLexical (ls.length + rs.length + 1) ls rs);
  if out.isEmpty = true then none else some (smd.UVal.map out)

def smd.itemKeyOk (ks : List GoString) (x : smd.UVal) : Prop :=
  (smd.keyOf ks x).isSome = true

structure smd.VWSt : Type where
  value : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value
  t : smd.TypeRef

def smd.listOfO : Option smd.UVal → Option (List smd.UVal) :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (smd.UVal.list vs) => some vs
  | x => none

def smd.isValO (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (dq : DFrac) : Option smd.UVal
    → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜v = GoInterface.nil⌝)
  | some x => smd.isValF v dq x

def smd.fuelL (ls rs : List smd.UVal) : Nat :=
  smd.UVal.sizeL ls + smd.UVal.sizeL rs + 1

def smd.isTVv (tv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.TypedValue) (sc : Loc) (S :
    smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜tv.schema' = sc⌝ ∗
      smd.isVal tv.value' x ∗ smd.isTypeRef tv.typeRef' t ∗ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF ∧ smd.conforms S t x⌝)

def smd.spareWalkers (V : Type) [TypedPointsto V] (sp : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜sp = null⌝ ∨
      ∃ sl ws,
        typedPointsto sp sl (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ownSlice sl ws (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            ownSliceCap Loc sl (DFrac.own 1) ∗ [∗list] w ∈ ws, iprop(∃ v, typedPointsto w v (DFrac.own 1)))

def (sealed) smd.isComparison (c : Loc) (C : smd.Cmp) : IProp GF

def smd.atomHandlerOk (A : smd.Atom) (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (T :
    go.GoType) (hv : val) (Pre : IProp GF) (Q : GoSlice → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  match A with
  | smd.Atom.map fields elem rel =>
    iprop(□
        ∀ Φ,
          Pre -∗
            (▷ ∀ errs, Q errs -∗ Φ (intoVal errs)) -∗
              WP ((intoVal (methods T go!"doMap" hv)) (intoVal a.Map')) {{ Φ }})
  | smd.Atom.scalar s =>
    iprop(□
        ∀ Φ,
          Pre -∗
            (▷ ∀ errs, Q errs -∗ Φ (intoVal errs)) -∗
              WP ((intoVal (methods T go!"doScalar" hv)) (intoVal a.Scalar'))
                {{ Φ }})
  | smd.Atom.list elem rel keys =>
    iprop(□
        ∀ Φ,
          Pre -∗
            (▷ ∀ errs, Q errs -∗ Φ (intoVal errs)) -∗
              WP ((intoVal (methods T go!"doList" hv)) (intoVal a.List')) {{ Φ }})

def smd.mwPooled (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v,
      typedPointsto w v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        ⌜v.out' = null ∧ v.inLeaf' = false⌝ ∗
          smd.ownPath v.path' [] ∗
            smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.mergingWalker v.spareWalkers' ∗
              (⌜v.allocator' = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ smd.isAlloc v.allocator'))

def smd.sizeO : Option smd.UVal → Nat :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => 0
  | some x => x.size

def smd.cmpMapOut (n : Nat) (S : smd.Schema) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option
    smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (ls rs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) : smd.Cmp :=
  smd.Cmp.unionAll
    (List.map
      (fun x =>
        match x with
        | (k, a, b) =>
          match smd.fieldType fs e k with
          | some t' => smd.cmpF n S t' (p ++ [smd.PE.field k]) a b
          | none => smd.Cmp.none)
      (smd.zipLexical (ls.length + rs.length + 1) ls rs))

def smd.errsIff (errs : GoSlice) (ok : Prop) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ es, smd.ownErrs errs es ∗ ⌜es = [] ↔ ok⌝)

def smd.mergeListOut (n : Nat) (S : smd.Schema) (e : smd.TypeRef) (ks : List GoString) (ls rs : List
    smd.UVal) : Option smd.UVal :=
  have out :=
    List.filterMap (fun pe => smd.mergeF n S e (smd.itemOf ks ls pe) (smd.itemOf ks rs pe))
      (smd.mergeKeys (smd.keysOf ks ls) (smd.keysOf ks rs));
  if out.isEmpty = true then none else some (smd.UVal.list out)

def smd.isListO (l : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.List') : Option (List smd.UVal) →
    IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜l = GoInterface.nil⌝)
  | some vs => smd.isListV l vs

def smd.mwCore (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.MWSt) (ps :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Path) (sp : Loc) (a :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Allocator) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tr rule o,
      typedPointsto w
          { lhs' := st.lhs, rhs' := st.rhs, schema' := sc, typeRef' := tr, path' := ps, rule' := rule,
            postItemHook' := func.nil, out' := o, inLeaf' := st.inLeaf, spareWalkers' := sp, allocator' := a }
          (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        smd.isTypeRef tr st.t ∗ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝ ∗ smd.ruleKeepRHSOk rule ∗ smd.outRep o st.out)

def smd.twPooled (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v,
      typedPointsto w v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        ⌜v.path' = slice.nil⌝ ∗
          smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.toFieldSetWalker v.spareWalkers')

def smd.isTVu (tv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.TypedValue) (sc : Loc) (S :
    smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) (dq : DFrac) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜tv.schema' = sc⌝ ∗ smd.isValF tv.value' dq x ∗ smd.isTypeRef tv.typeRef' t ∗ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝)

def smd.rmOwn (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value)
    (rp : Loc) (R : smd.PathSet) (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Allocator) (out :
    GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(typedPointsto w
        { value' := v, out' := out, schema' := sc, toRemove' := rp, allocator' := a, shouldExtract' := false }
        (DFrac.own 1) ∗
      smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝ ∗ smd.isSet rp R ∗ smd.isAlloc a)

def smd.cwPooled (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v,
      typedPointsto w v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        ⌜v.inLeaf' = false⌝ ∗
          smd.ownPath v.path' [] ∗
            smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.compareWalker v.spareWalkers' ∗
              (⌜v.allocator' = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ smd.isAlloc v.allocator'))

def smd.prefixOk (fn : GoFunc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜fn = func.nil⌝ ∨ □ ∀ Φ, True -∗ (▷ ∀ s, True -∗ Φ (intoVal s)) -∗ WP ((intoVal fn) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def smd.vwCore (w sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (st : smd.VWSt) (sp : Loc) (a :
    sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Allocator) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tr,
      typedPointsto w
          { value' := st.value, schema' := sc, typeRef' := tr, allowDuplicates' := false, spareWalkers' := sp,
            allocator' := a }
          (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        smd.isTypeRef tr st.t ∗ smd.isSchema sc S ∗ ⌜S.WF⌝)

def smd.typedPools : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ f,
        typedPointsto (globalAddr sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.ruleKeepRHS) f DFrac.discard ∗
          smd.ruleKeepRHSOk f) ∗
      (∃ f,
          sync.isPool (globalAddr sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.mwPool) f iprop(True)
            (smd.pooledAs sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.mergingWalker.ty smd.mwPooled)) ∗
        (∃ f,
            sync.isPool (globalAddr sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.cmpwPool) f iprop(True)
              (smd.pooledAs sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.compareWalker.ty smd.cwPooled)) ∗
          (∃ f,
              sync.isPool (globalAddr sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.tPool) f iprop(True)
                (smd.pooledAs sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.toFieldSetWalker.ty smd.twPooled)) ∗
            (∃ f,
                sync.isPool (globalAddr sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.vPool) f iprop(True)
                  (smd.pooledAs sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.validatingObjectWalker.ty smd.vwPooled)) ∗
              ∃ f,
                sync.isPool (globalAddr sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.fmPool) f iprop(True)
                  (smd.pooledAs sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.reconcileWithSchemaWalker.ty smd.rwPooled))

def smd.ruleKeepRHSOk (f : GoFunc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ w v dql dqr l r,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            typedPointsto w v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                smd.isValO v.lhs' dql l ∗ smd.isValO v.rhs' dqr r ∗ ⌜l.isSome = true ∨ r.isSome = true⌝ -∗
              ▷
                  ((∃ o,
                      typedPointsto w
                          { lhs' := v.lhs', rhs' := v.rhs', schema' := v.schema', typeRef' := v.typeRef',
                            path' := v.path', rule' := v.rule', postItemHook' := v.postItemHook', out' := o,
                            inLeaf' := v.inLeaf', spareWalkers' := v.spareWalkers', allocator' := v.allocator' }
                          (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                        smd.outRep o (smd.leafM l r) ∗ smd.isValO v.lhs' dql l ∗ smd.isValO v.rhs' dqr r) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal f) (intoVal w)) {{ Φ }})

def smd.cmpListOut (n : Nat) (S : smd.Schema) (e : smd.TypeRef) (ks : List GoString) (p : smd.Path)
    (ls rs : List smd.UVal) : smd.Cmp :=
  have pes := smd.keysOf ks ls ++ List.filter (fun x => decide ¬x ∈ smd.keysOf ks ls) (smd.keysOf ks rs);
  smd.Cmp.unionAll (List.map (fun pe => smd.cmpF n S e (p ++ [pe]) (smd.itemOf ks ls pe) (smd.itemOf ks rs pe)) pes)

def smd.optU : Option smd.PathSet → Option smd.PathSet → Option smd.PathSet :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | none, b => b
  | a, none => a
  | some a, some b => some (a.union b)

structure smd.CWSt : Type where
  lhs : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value
  rhs : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value
  t : smd.TypeRef
  path : smd.Path
  inLeaf : Bool

def smd.rwPooled (w : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v,
      typedPointsto w v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        ⌜v.path' = slice.nil ∧ v.isAtomic' = false ∧ v.toRemove' = null ∧ v.toAdd' = null⌝ ∗
          smd.spareWalkers sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.reconcileWithSchemaWalker v.spareWalkers')
